content: Silence is the absolute balance of body, mind, and spirit.
author: Native American Proverbs
sourceWork: Ohiyesa (Charles Eastman) — The Soul of the Indian
explanation: To the traditional indigenous mind, silence is not the absence of sound; it is the presence of sacred balance. A person who cannot sit in total silence without twitching, speaking, or reaching for distraction is spiritually unwell. Silence is the sanctuary of self-control and true presence.
practicalInsight: Sit in absolute, motionless silence for five minutes today. Let your body, mind, and spirit settle into balance.
reflectionPrompt: Why does silent stillness make you anxious, and what would happen if you befriended it?
